bankruptcy.subtitle: Bankruptcy proceedings, administrators and legislation in Croatia

overview.title: What is Bankruptcy?
overview.text: Bankruptcy (stečaj) in Croatia is regulated by the Stečajni zakon (NN 71/15, 104/17, 36/22). It is a legal procedure initiated when a debtor becomes insolvent or over-indebted. The goal is to collectively satisfy creditors through liquidation of assets or financial restructuring.

sections.listingsDesc: Published bankruptcy notices, creditor calls and asset auctions
sections.debtorsDesc: Directory of debtors with each profile and the full history of linked cases
sections.administratorsDesc: Licensed bankruptcy administrators and their contact information
sections.legislationDesc: Stečajni zakon and related EU directives

process.title: The Bankruptcy Process
process.step1: 1. Petition — Filed by debtor or creditor with the commercial court
process.step2: 2. Opening — Court examines solvency; if accepted, bankruptcy is opened
process.step3: 3. Administrator — Court appoints a bankruptcy administrator (stečajni upravitelj)
process.step4: 4. Resolution — Assets liquidated or restructuring plan approved by creditors

legalAid.title: Free Legal Aid
legalAid.intro: The Republic of Croatia provides free legal aid (besplatna pravna pomoć) to persons who cannot afford legal representation. The system is governed by the Zakon o besplatnoj pravnoj pomoći (NN 143/13, 98/19).

primary.title: Primary Legal Aid
primary.desc: General legal information, advice, and assistance filling in forms for administrative and judicial proceedings. Provided free of charge without means testing.

secondary.title: Secondary Legal Aid
secondary.desc: Full legal representation in court proceedings, including a lawyer appointed by the Croatian Bar Association. Subject to a means test and case merits assessment.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.income: Household income does not exceed the threshold (approx. €441/month per member). Special categories include: victims of domestic violence, asylum seekers, persons with disabilities, and minors.

howToApply.title: How to Apply
howToApply.step1: 1. Submit application form to your county court (županijski sud) or Ministry of Justice office
howToApply.step2: 2. Attach proof of income (employer certificate, social welfare confirmation)
howToApply.step3: 3. The court decides within 15 days; approved applicants receive a referral to a licensed lawyer

about.title: About Us
about.intro1: Sudačka mreža (Judicial Network) is a non-profit association that for over twenty years has been collecting, processing, and publishing publicly relevant data from the judicial system of the Republic of Croatia. Our goal is judicial transparency and the accessibility of legal information to all citizens.
about.intro2: The platform offers searchable databases of case law (Supreme Court, High Commercial Court, European Court of Human Rights), a court directory with an interactive jurisdiction map, a directory of court experts and interpreters, bankruptcy estate sale listings, and an overview of relevant legislation.
about.intro3: All services are available free of charge. Registration is only required to access contact details of court professionals.

cookies.policyIntro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, which cookies we use, their purposes, and how you can control them. By using our platform you consent to the use of cookies described in this document.

policySection1.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
policySection1.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember your preferences and improve your experience. Cookies cannot run programs or transmit viruses.

cookies.row4Purpose: Anonymous visit analytics (Google Analytics) — only with consent

policySection3.title: 3. Managing Cookies
policySection3.p1: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. Instructions for managing cookies in popular browsers:
policySection3.li1: Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies
policySection3.li2: Mozilla Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
policySection3.li3: Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Manage Website Data
policySection3.li4: Microsoft Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions

policySection4.title: 4. More Information
policySection4.p1: Disabling essential cookies may impair platform functionality. You can opt out of analytics cookies at any time via the consent banner.
policySection4.p2: For more information on how we process your personal data, see our

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Sudačka mreža ('we', 'our', 'Sudačka mreža') is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use and protect your personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Croatian data-protection law.

section1.title: 1. Data We Collect
section1.p1: We collect the following categories of personal data depending on how you use our platform:
section1.li1: Account data: name, email address and hashed password on registration
section1.li2: Usage data: pages visited, searches performed and saved decisions
section1.li3: Device data: IP address, browser type and operating system
section1.li4: Contact form data: name, email address and message content

section2.title: 2. Legal Basis for Processing
section2.p1: We process your personal data under the following legal bases:
section2.li1: Contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): to provide services to registered users
section2.li2: Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): for platform security and service improvement
section2.li3: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): for analytics cookies (only with your consent)

section3.title: 3. Data Retention
section3.p1: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected:
section3.li1: Account data: duration of the account + 30 days after deletion
section3.li3: Contact form data: 2 years from receipt

section4.title: 4. Your Rights
section4.p1: As a data subject you have the following rights under the GDPR:
section4.li1: Right of access: you may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
section4.li2: Right to rectification: you may request correction of inaccurate data
section4.li3: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten'): you may request deletion of data no longer needed
section4.li4: Right to data portability: you may request your data in a structured, machine-readable format
section4.li5: Right to object: you may object to processing based on legitimate interests
section4.p2: Submit requests to: info@sudacka-mreza.hr. We respond within 30 days.

section5.title: 5. Supervisory Authority — AZOP
section5.p1: If you believe that processing of your personal data infringes GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP):

section6.title: 6. Changes to This Policy
section6.p1: We reserve the right to update this Policy. We will notify you of material changes by email or platform notice at least 14 days before they take effect. Continued use of the platform after that period constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.
